B Labour Laws : Factories Act, 1948-Section 6(/)(d)-The Andhra Pradesh Factories c Rules, 1950-Rule 5-Licencefee-Applicability of the principle of quid pro quo-Held, since it is a regulatory fee and not a fee for special services rendered the principle of quid pro quo does not apply. Andhra the licence fee from Rs. 10, 000 to Rs. 18, 00, 000-Whether valid-Held, it is D grossly high and excessive and therefore arbitrary.
